reason: The analyst ran one specification on the central-region subsample only (N=661), with no justification given, and also trimmed the outcome. That does not answer the question for all firms, and it leaves out the full pre-treatment controls. My full-sample analysis (10 specifications, pre-treatment controls only) also finds no significant effect (-0.28, SE 0.24), but the analyst's estimate (+0.12, SE 0.38) has a different sign and rests on an unsupported subgroup choice, so I would not release it as it stands. I could not re-run any code in this environment, so I did not check whether the effect differs by region.
